prompt: Struct `S { char tag; int val; long big; }` is laid out with natural alignment. Write the field accesses.
template:
get_tag:
    {{0}} eax, byte ptr [rdi]
    ret
get_val:
    mov eax, dword ptr [rdi + {{1}}]
    ret
get_big:
    mov rax, [rdi + {{2}}]
    ret
explain: `tag` is at 0 and takes 1 byte; `val` needs 4-byte alignment, so it is at 4; `big` needs 8, so it is at 8, and the struct is 16 bytes. A `char` is signed here, so it is sign-extended.
